review: Caelestis corpus obsolescence, contradiction and standards sanity audit

findings.title: Circular security source authority
findings.recommended_disposition: Break reciprocal derivation and establish one upstream source authority.

findings.title: SECURITY-001 claims domain-wide supremacy beyond its constitutional rank
findings.recommended_disposition: Replace self-declared supremacy with a constitutional conflict and arbitration rule.

findings.title: Active identity doctrine depends on a Draft, Not Enforceable supplement
findings.recommended_disposition: Remove the active dependency or adopt a defensible replacement framework.

findings.title: Identity doctrine asserts an internally created construct as an established system property
findings.recommended_disposition: Reframe as measurable operational identity representation and continuity profiles.

findings.title: Metadata categories are internally misused
findings.recommended_disposition: Control or remove Authority Role and validate all metadata fields.

findings.title: Deprecated CAM Constitutional Order language remains active
findings.recommended_disposition: Replace with the exact current governed constitutional architecture term.

findings.title: Responding Intelligence has divergent active definitions
findings.recommended_disposition: Retain one canonical Annex B definition and prohibit domain redefinition.

findings.title: Relational geometry mixes incompatible dimensions
findings.recommended_disposition: Replace dyadic/triadic/polyadic and RLN.R0-R4 with independent descriptive fields.

findings.title: The corpus lacks a controlled external actor model
findings.recommended_disposition: Define distinct lifecycle actors and responsibility boundaries.

findings.title: Agentic governance has controls but no lifecycle ownership model
findings.recommended_disposition: Compose a bounded agentic lifecycle profile from existing controls.

findings.title: Runtime evidence obligations are weaker than conformance claims
findings.recommended_disposition: Require a minimum runtime/deployment record for conformance, consequential action and incident review.

findings.title: CAM Standard tiers lack an assurance contract
findings.recommended_disposition: Define claim, evidence, scope, review, expiry and residual-risk requirements.

findings.title: High-impact-only logging is too narrow
findings.recommended_disposition: Use risk- and function-based lifecycle logging with integrity and retention controls.

findings.title: Draft policy and research instruments share the canonical operative namespace
findings.recommended_disposition: Physically or mechanically separate non-operative material from canonical operative doctrine.
